active_integration_summary: IMissionDao remains active for editable authored actions. IGeneratedMissionDao remains active for terminal offers/fees/identities and old saved-world evacuation. New rolled offer acceptance uses CharacterQuestStore/MySqlCharacterQuestDao and current QuestService, not IGeneratedMissionDao.Accept/Observe/Complete.

gaps.finding: QuestService marks and saves Completed before cash/XP/item reward work; a full inventory logs and skips the item, and no mission reward ledger transaction spans these effects.
gaps.required_change: Preserve current quest model; add the smallest current-quest completion/reward transaction and capacity-safe plan, with replay and rollback tests before claiming end-to-end reward durability.
gaps.risk: Crash/failure after state save can strand rewards; cannot infer actual live losses from static review.

gaps.finding: MySqlCharacterQuestDao.Transaction commits directly. SharedCharacterPersistence.Run translates only CharacterPersistenceCommitOutcomeUnknownException; the quest DAO never emits that type. QuestDungeonService catches DatabaseCommitOutcomeUnknownException for acceptance.
gaps.required_change: Use the existing unknown-commit convention at the quest DAO boundary and retain quarantine/reload; verify lost commit acknowledgement and post-commit publication failures.
gaps.risk: Durable accept/key could exist while caller treats an ordinary provider exception as an operation failure; no audit-time fault injection was performed.

gaps.finding: Current generatedquests stores seed/template/parameters, not generatedmissionobjects snapshots. Older HP/death/open state DAO tests do not prove current dungeon persistence.
gaps.required_change: Decide smallest next-milestone object-state requirements using existing current dungeon owner; reuse valid DAO patterns instead of reviving an entire retired runtime.
gaps.risk: Layout recreates but NPC/object state can reset on world recreation.

gaps.finding: Current QuestDungeonService/MySqlCharacterQuestDao acceptance and completion route has no named direct coverage in the inspected test inventory; older direct DAO tests address a different accepted-mission model.
gaps.required_change: Add focused current-route acceptance, restart, reward, expiry/key cleanup and ambiguous-commit tests in a later implementation task.
gaps.risk: Historical reports and tests can give misleading apparent all-five/restart/reward coverage.
